_comment: Boundary manifest: core/modules import-isolation policy. The modules_root and module_prefixes entries are forward-looking placeholders. V2 capability modules (BFT, Temporal, Analyst, Forensics, PoD, etc.) are delivered as separate installable packages that register via the exoarmur.* entry-point groups in src/exoarmur/plugins/registry.py, NOT bundled under modules/. allowed_core_externals enumerates the subset that core may import directly when installed.
